errors.evidence: The description incorrectly implies the unit for the left chart ('числото на докладите' - number of reports) is 'лева' (BGN). The left chart's unit is 'доклада' (reports), while the right chart's unit is 'млрд. лв.' (billion BGN).
The phrase 'but it is very simplified' is a subjective evaluation of the legend's appearance, which is an interpretation rather than an objective description of the chart's content.
The word 'еталоните' (which translates to 'standards' or 'benchmarks') is an awkward and unclear choice to refer to the data values or labels. A clearer term would be 'стойностите' (the values).
